chunks.text: I'm Emily and today I will teach you how to speak English at an auction.
An auction is a place where different items or services are sold and people place bids to buy them.
You can find artwork, collectibles, houses, cars, and even celebrity items at auctions.
If you are attending an auction for the first time, the process might seem a bit confusing.
How do you place a bid?
Why does the auctioneer speak so fast?
Before you can place a bid, you need to register for the auction.
There is usually a registration desk where you must show your ID and sometimes pay a deposit.
I'd like to register for the auction.
What do I need to do to bid?
Do I need to pay a deposit?
Can I get a bidding number?
Is there an online bidding option?
I'd like to register for the auction.
Please fill out this form and show your ID.
Do I need to pay a deposit?
No, but you need to collect a bidding number.
Some auctions require online registration in advance.
So always check before you go.
Many auctions allow participants to preview the items before bidding begins.
You may want to ask questions about the condition, history, or authenticity of an item.
Can I take a closer look at this item?
What is the starting bid for this?
Can I take a closer look at this painting?
This is an original piece from 1890.
Most auctions have a catalog listing all items for sale.
Reading the catalog beforehand can help you prepare.
During an auction, the auctioneer speaks very fast and uses special terms.
Here are some important words you need to know.
The initial price of an item.
Bid to place an offer for an item.
The auctioneer's final call before selling an item.
The minimum price the seller is willing to accept.
The final price at which an item is sold.
A number assigned to each bidder.
Going once, going twice, sold for $700.
Tip if the auctioneer speaks too fast, focus on the numbers and decide when to place your bid.
If you want to buy an item, you can raise your paddle or place a verbal bid.
I want to increase my bid.
Tip don't let emotions take over.
Some people get too competitive and bid more than they planned.
If you win the bid, you need to pay for your item and arrange for collection.
Useful phrases for payment and collection.
How do I pay for my item?
Can I pay by credit card?
You can pay by card or cash.
Today, you learned how to speak English at an auction.
I hope this episode was helpful.
Thank you for listening and see you in the next episode.
